description: This file contains the implementation of the ExceptionContext class used in the Apache Commons Math library. It manages exception-related information, including messages, context data, and serialization logic.

classes.name: ExceptionContext
classes.description: A class that encapsulates detailed context information for exceptions, including messages, arbitrary data, and serialization support.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the Throwable associated with this context.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Adds a localized message pattern with arguments to the context.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the context data.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key in the context.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns all keys stored in the context.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the default message string for the context.

methods.name: getLocalizedMessage
methods.description: Returns the message string localized to the default locale.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message string localized to a specified locale.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message string from message patterns and arguments, with localization and separator.

methods.name: writeObject
methods.description: Serializes the object to an output stream.

methods.name: readObject
methods.description: Deserializes the object from an input stream.

methods.name: nonSerializableReplacement
methods.description: Provides a string replacement for objects that are not serializable.
